title: CF MONTREAL ARE FOR SALE AFTER 34 YEARS, AND THERE IS NO PRICE YET
description:
Eleven managers in 14 seasons, last in the East, and now a for-sale sign.

Joey Saputo says it's time to find new ownership at CF Montreal. His family has owned the club since 1992.

Montreal finished last in the East with 26 points and six wins in 34 games. Not the glossiest sales brochure. They fired Marco Donadel in April, their 11th manager in 14 seasons.

Saputo prefers a local buyer, but may accept a relocation offer. Plan A, and a very polite Plan B. BMO Capital Markets and National Bank Financial are advising. No price has been given. Plenty of bankers, no number.

Local owner or a relocation offer: which would you rather see happen? Give us your pick.
